name: io.github.taewankung/ai-rover-mcp
title: AI Rover Studio
description: Let an AI agent drive a 2D robot rover simulator in the browser: sensors, camera, wiring and code.

environmentVariables.name: ROVER_SIMULATOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Simulator page that open_simulator opens: a URL or a path to a local build. Default: https://ai-rover.app/app/?mcp=on

environmentVariables.name: ROVER_BRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local WebSocket port the simulator page connects to. Default: 8765

environmentVariables.name: ROVER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Extra comma-separated https origins the bridge accepts
